messages:
alex_k: pushed a tiny hotpatch for Monarch enterprise private deploy — fixes an NGINX proxy header problem that was breaking healthchecks behind the v2 gateway. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1892 

maria_r: can someone take a look? customer is in a maintenance window and wants this merged ASAP. SLA ticket: #MON-4482 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

noah_w: on it, leaving a quick pass now. main risk is the config toggle for `use_forwarded_host` — we need to ensure it doesn't flip for other tenants.

jen_cto: fyi this is a private deploy change (monarch-prod-vpc). If it looks good we should merge to the customer branch and kick the canary first. ops runbook updated here: https://confluence.redwood/monarch/runbooks/healthcheck-fix

noah_w: quick review notes:
- move the `proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host` into the conditional block for `env.MONARCH=true`
- add a test config in `deploy/monarch/staging/nginx.conf.sample` so we can catch regressions

alex_k: thanks — added both suggestions in a follow-up commit. also added a short test in `infra/tests/config_validation_test.py` to assert header presence when MONARCH is set.

merge-bot: CI passed — unit 142/142, integration smoke ok. PR checks: required-reviewers=2, security-scan=passed.

maria_r: @noah_w @jen_cto can one of you approve so I can merge before the end of the window?

noah_w: approved. left a comment about log level but not blocking.

jen_cto: approved, please merge and follow canary plan. I'll monitor logs and perf during rollout.

alex_k: merged to `monarch/customer-1892-hotfix` and kicked the canary job `deploy/monarch/canary/2026-03-17-22:05`. cc @ops-bot

ops-bot: Canary started — instances: 2, target region: us-west-2. Healthchecks: initializing. Monitor: https://ops.redwood/monarch/canaries/1892

maria_r: thanks everyone. will update customer and close the SLA once canary is healthy. :party_parrot:
